_about: Furan (1) + n-Hexane (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.0 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of furan, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of furan, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).
